verdict.rationale: Groq documents image inputs on its Responses API (vision), and its official TypeScript SDK shows audio transcription with a Whisper model, so non-text modalities are callable on the same platform and API key. Evidence is thin: one docs sentence for vision and one SDK snippet for audio. missing for 10: image-generation models, dedicated vision/speech documentation (supported models, limits), text-to-speech evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: The Responses API supports both text and image inputs while producing text outputs
